findings.claim_location: Section 4.4 Lemma 1 p.5; Appendix A Eqs.5-6 p.16; abstract/introduction theoretical contribution; Appendix E interpretation
findings.assumptions: Two finite keys in R^3, nonzero query, per-token asymmetric round-to-nearest B=2 with positive ranges and no ties. Query scaling absorbed exactly. A separate example grants Appendix A's iid Gaussian-coordinate model.
findings.argument: K1=(.49,0,1), K2=(.48,0,1.2), effective q=(1000,0,0). Exact stated quantization gives Khat1=(1/3,0,1), Khat2=(.4,0,1.2). Logit margin changes from 10 to -200/3, attention from .9999546021 to 1.114383e-29. Gaussian example in independent_checks.json has flip probability .4991537163.
findings.alternatives: Fixed bounded projected errors with a diverging margin do preserve concentration. Empirical correlations may hold. Case 1 common projected errors yields a non-sparse robust family and is explicitly acknowledged by paper, but no premise excludes it.
findings.dependency: Core theoretical attention-pattern explanation -> interpretation of sensitivity and offline mixed-precision motivation; numerical search usefulness and empirical score tables are not disproved.
findings.impact: The derivation cannot establish concentration-only robustness or exclusivity; this is material core-theory damage.
findings.correction: With original margin >=m and pairwise projected error differences <=rho, a_hat_i >=1/(1+(S-1)exp(-m+rho)). Bound proved; only conditional single-head guarantee, no full-model or prompt-independent result.
findings.later_version: Targeted arXiv v5 Lemma 1 and Appendix A check retains the same claim and approximation.

findings.claim_location: Section 5.3 and D.1.2 layer grouping; search_optuna_adaptive.py lines37-43,176-185,218-228
findings.assumptions: Pinned source configurations; prerequisites assumed available for control-flow implication; no author execution.
findings.argument: Qwen14 per-channel repeats layer 25: 49 memberships for 48 layers, with uniform KV4 objective 4.083333 rather than 4. Qwen32 repeats layers 22, 24, and 25; group index 2 violates SPECIAL_LAYERS, triggering the explicit ValueError before search.
findings.alternatives: Main reported 3B/7B/8B searched configurations are different; uniform 14B/32B measurements need not use these groups; historical effects not established.
findings.dependency: Released grouping -> precision map/cost or preparation failure for the two settings.
findings.impact: Local reproducibility and nominal memory objective affected, not a general algorithm impossibility.
findings.correction: Removing layers 22, 24, and 25 from Qwen32 group index 2 gives a complete, disjoint 64-layer partition compatible with the templates; this data-level repair was verified. Sum the distinct-layer mapping to avoid cost duplicates; performance remains unverified.

findings.claim_location: Section5.3 p.7 and Appendix E.1 p.23 prefilling; flexible_quantized_cache.py lines173-190
findings.assumptions: force_quant=True, residual_length32, new cache with64 tokens; no author runtime execution.
findings.argument: r = 64 % 32 = 0; prefix[:-0] is empty, while suffix[-0:] retains all 64 tokens, contrary to intended full-prefix quantization.
findings.alternatives: r>0 or R=0 do not have this same boundary problem; released search sets force_quant=False; some backends may reject empty input instead; historical usage unverified.
findings.dependency: Prefilling-enabled quantization path -> quantized vs retained token split.
findings.impact: Localized implementation defect; no numerical historical table damage demonstrated.
findings.correction: cut=S-r; prefix[:cut],suffix[cut:] yields intended boundary partition. Verified slicing only, not full backend behavior.
